// diagnostic

E0305

Pattern doesn't belong to value's type

What

Pattern doesn't belong to value's type

Why

A pattern can only test a value of the type it describes

Fix

Make the pattern's shape and types match the value.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0305: Tests/UI/UnionArmNamesTwoMembers/stderr.

Error [jet.PatternTypeMismatch]: Pattern `Point` names more than one member of `geo2.Point | map2.Point`
  --> Tests/UI/UnionArmNamesTwoMembers/run.jet:10:9
    |
 10 |         .Point(_) -> print("a point")
    |         ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The union holds 2 types named `Point`, and an arm names a member by its type's name alone
 Fix: Make each a named case of the union, as in `Point1(geo2.Point) | Point2(map2.Point)`, and match the case: `.Point1(p) -> …`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0305
